rules: Reversed polarity requires a location-specific marking (pin 1, +/-, silkscreen, cathode band/stripe, or a keying feature). A part that is only crooked, shifted, overhanging, or rotated on its pad is Component misalignment / skewed.
Billboarding (a chip part standing up on its side) is coded as Tombstoning (component lifts on one end).
Resistance (ohm) readings out of spec, opens, and shorts found in test are coded as Continuity Test Failure.
Torque problems are coded as Torque Defect, including fasteners that back off or move, damaged or galled threads, and torque that was not verified with a calibrated tool.
Entries that are not real defect descriptions, or are too vague to classify (for example 'assembly is bad'), get no code.
